findings.description: Retrieval: nine pages downloaded with curl (HTTP 200): the three brief lists (S1-S3) and six official profile/announcement pages (S4-S9). Hashes are SHA-256 of the exact downloaded bytes. Staff directory page excluded per the brief.

Enumeration: S1 yields 29 cards, S2 yields 25, S3 yields 20 (74 total). Names match brief.people one-to-one after normalization (honorifics, middle initials, punctuation). No person is on a list but missing from the brief, and none is in the brief but missing from the lists. No omissions.
Owner determinations applied only where the person is in this brief: Tim Kane. The Arkadan, Abolhassani and Kalavakonda determinations do not apply to this roster.

owner determination 2026-11-25: Tim Kane (University of New Mexico ECE Chair): the owner states he is a professor and department chair (the UNM announcement describes his Penn State faculty career since 1994). Decide regular / ece / current. Downloaded official pages S1, S4 and S5 state 'Chair' and describe his faculty career and do not contradict this. effective_from_json is null because the announcement gives 'beginning Aug. 11' without a stated year. Outcome changes only if an official page is found that states a non-professorial or non-chair role.

Abdallah listed on S2 with an empty title; profile S6 confirms 'Professor Emeritus'. Excluded as emeritus (past). Outcome would change only if an official page showed a current professorial appointment.

David Modisette is on the main faculty list (S1) with 'Adjunct Professor' and his profile (S9) matches. Excluded as adjunct, not regular, because the only ECE role is adjunct. Outcome would change only if an official source showed a regular or courtesy professorial ECE appointment.

Khanh Pham: 'Adjunct Research Professor' (S3, S7). Assigned adjunct, not research_only, because the explicit adjunct appointment governs. Both categories are excluded, so the count is unchanged either way.

Ioannis Papapanagiotou: 'Research Assistant Professor, Temp Part-time Faculty' (S3, S8). Assigned research_only. Would change to adjunct only if an official source states an adjunct appointment. Both categories are excluded.
Five lecturer/senior-lecturer titles on the main list (Elshafiey, Nava, Palacios, Sharma, Tavakoli) are teaching, excluded. Titles are on S1.
